settings.target_norm_statistic: nanmedian / nanstd (the statistics the checkpoint itself uses) over the target's finite entries, pooled over original and home/away-swapped features exactly as training pooled them
settings.binary_rule: feature left at checkpoint stats if every finite target value is in {0,1}
settings.mix: equal number of fold-TRAIN windows per epoch, true labels, plain factorized NLL, training window/gap-alternate choice taken from the cached training records
settings.target_windows: 10 s cores / 5 s context, original and home/away-swapped copies, frames with ensemble max probability >= 0.90 only

pass_if: no provider's feed_like or clean spellF1 drops by more than 0.02
decision_rule.aggregation: replicates within match, matches within provider, providers equally
